title: Quinoa vegetable pan with chickpeas
steps: Rinse the quinoa well in a sieve and simmer it covered in 280 ml salted water for about 15 minutes, then let it rest for 5 minutes.
Finely chop the onion and garlic, cut the broccoli into small florets and the pepper into strips.
Heat the oil in a large pan, sweat the onion and garlic for 2 minutes, add the broccoli and pepper and fry for 6–8 minutes until just tender.
Rinse the chickpeas, add them to the pan with the cumin and fry for 2 more minutes.
Fold in the quinoa, season with lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve topped with crumbled feta.
